encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key bytewise XOR in place: buffer[i] ^= key[i % 18]
encryption_details.key_storage: Stored in plaintext at .rdata VA 0x140004000. The key is not NUL-terminated; code supplies the hard-coded length 0x12. It is immediately adjacent to the plaintext ntdll.dll string. The 64-byte encoded payload is stored at .data VA 0x140003000.

decoded_strings.decoded_text_strings: No encrypted text/API strings were recovered; the XOR-protected object is a 64-byte payload rather than readable text.

anti_analysis: Dynamically resolves NtQueryInformationProcess and queries information class 7 (ProcessDebugPort), treating a returned value of 0xffffffff as debugger presence.
Queries NtQueryInformationProcess information class 0x1f (ProcessDebugFlags), treating a returned value of zero as debugger presence.
Exits before decoding and injection when either debugger check succeeds.

injection_details.method: Native-API remote-thread injection: NtCreateProcess -> NtAllocateVirtualMemory -> NtWriteVirtualMemory -> NtCreateThreadEx
injection_details.target_process: A newly created native child process with the current process supplied as ParentProcess and a NULL SectionHandle; there is no named executable or pre-existing target process.
injection_details.target_discovery: No enumeration or name lookup. The sample calls GetCurrentProcessId, opens itself with OpenProcess access 0x80 (PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS), and passes that handle to NtCreateProcess as ParentProcess.
injection_details.process_creation: NtCreateProcess requests access 0x1fffff, uses a zeroed OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES structure, does not inherit the object table, and supplies NULL section/debug/exception handles.
injection_details.payload_preparation: Copies the static 64-byte blob from .data to the stack and decodes it with repeating-key XOR using the 18-byte plaintext key Gh0stPr0c3ssH0ll0w.
injection_details.payload_write: NtAllocateVirtualMemory allocates 64 bytes in the child at an arbitrary address using MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT (0x3000) and PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40). NtWriteVirtualMemory then writes the entire decoded 64-byte blob and records the byte count.
injection_details.execution: NtCreateThreadEx creates a thread whose start address is the remote RWX allocation and whose argument is NULL. CreateFlags is zero; despite that, the code subsequently calls NtResumeThread, waits on the thread for 5000 ms, and closes the thread/process handles with NtClose.
injection_details.not_process_hollowing: No target image name, NtUnmapViewOfSection, thread-context replacement, PE remapping, or entry-point overwrite is present; this is allocated-memory remote-thread injection rather than conventional process hollowing.
